The mutation response is documented, not recorded: recording it would need a mutating call. body.query: query($owner: String!, $name: String!, $number: Int!) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $name) { autoMergeAllowed pullRequest(number: $number) { id number headRefOid baseRefName isDraft title state merged isMergeQueueEnabled isInMergeQueue labels(first: 100) { nodes { name } } autoMergeRequest { mergeMethod } } } }
